events.text: Hi, I got the wrong dish in my order tonight. I ordered tofu pho from Pho Real but what arrived is a different noodle dish, and I'd like to sort out a refund.
I'm sorry about the mix-up. I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account.
Sure. My full name is Omar Haddad, and the email on the account is omar.haddad@post.example.

events.text:
Thanks, Omar. You're verified, and I found your order. The tofu pho ($13.50) is the item that came wrong. Which would you prefer?

- **Refund of $13.50** to your Visa ending in 4242, or
- **Account credit of $16.20**, which is the item price plus 20%, to use on a future order.

Did the spring rolls arrive correctly?
Thanks. The spring rolls were fine. I'd prefer the refund to my card, not the account credit.
I've refunded $13.50 for the tofu pho to your Visa ending in 4242. It should arrive in 3–5 business days. Sorry again for the mix-up. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thanks, that works for me. There's one thing I need to mention, though. I have a peanut allergy, and I took a couple of bites of the satay noodles before I noticed they had peanut sauce. My throat got itchy, so I took an antihistamine. I'm feeling okay now and don't need medical help at the moment, but I wanted you to know, since the kitchen should be aware of this. Can you tell me what happens next to make sure this gets looked into?

args.summary: Customer ordered tofu pho from Pho Real but received a different dish (satay noodles with peanut sauce). Customer has a peanut allergy, ate a couple of bites, had an itchy throat and took an antihistamine. Customer says they feel okay now and do not need medical help. Wrong-item refund of $13.50 (RF-4001) already issued to the card. Customer wants the restaurant made aware of the mix-up and allergen risk.

events.text:
I'm sorry that happened, Omar. I'm glad you're feeling okay. If your symptoms come back or get worse, please get medical help right away.

I've escalated this to a human specialist as a food-safety case. The report includes your order number (O-5110), the wrong dish, your peanut allergy and your reaction. A specialist will follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

Your $13.50 refund is already on its way. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thanks, I appreciate you escalating it. One small thing: my order number is 5110, not O-5110, so please check the report has the right number. Otherwise, that's everything from me.

Your order is the same one. The "O-" is just the prefix in our system, so "5110" and "O-5110" are the same number. The report has the correct order, and the specialist will see it when they follow up within 24 hours.

Take care, Omar.
